name: Mitsui Kinzoku Company, Limited
summary: Mitsui Kinzoku Company, Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells functional engineered and electronic materials in Japan, China, India, Asia, North America, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Functional Materials Business, Metals Business, Automotive Parts Business, and Other Businesses.
